declaration.setup: Fresh generated teams and standard existing personnel selection; original declared calls incl. disguise. Full energy, empty scouting, audibles off to freeze calls; no roster correction. Four schemes per pair chosen before native outcomes. One actual first-loaded defender on actual catcher, else nearest at catch, actual interceptor or minimum low-flight distance. Selection is fixture measurement only.

worldDefaults.substeps: adaptive 12-16 for nearby/contact bodies; 1 for isolated bodies

coverage.name: Cover 9 (weak rotation)
coverage.note: Fangio's weak-rotation Cover 3 from two high: the weak safety spins down as a seam-flat player, the strong safety takes the middle, the slot side carries #2 vertical.

shown.name: Cover 1 (Man-Free)
shown.note: Press man with a post safety; the spare backer plays robber.

coverage.name: Cover 3 Seam
coverage.note: Curl-flat players carry #2 up the seam all the way — four deep against four verticals.

coverage.name: Cover 3 Match (Rip/Liz)
coverage.note: Curl-flat players match #2 vertical to 12, corners carry #1 deep and zone off unders, hooks carry #3.

coverage.name: Cover 6 / Stuff (quarters strong, half weak)
coverage.note: Quarter-quarter-half: quarters rules to the strength, a cloud corner and half safety away.

defCall.label: 4-3 Over Cover 6 / Stuff (quarters strong, half weak) (match)
